answers.core: Having it in core is the only way to really use this in an efficient workflow. I also believe that this is a feature that will help quite some users while not adding much complexity.
answers.workaround: This is core physics behavior. There is no way to work around it easily. One can write an editor script that takes a shape, calculates the center of mass, and then offsets all polygon shapes to make the origin the same as the center of mass. However this is cumbersome and a lot more than "worked around with a few lines".

title: Improve automatic center of mass determination for polygon shapes
